main_text.head: NOVÆO, REDVCI.
main_text.p:
QVis claustra tetri carceris abdita,
Quis vincla tandem rupit ahenea,
Plures quis amissum per annos
Restituit reducem Nouæum?

Nam te cauernis luce carentibus
Vinctum, seueris excubijs Iber
Horrens tenebat, ne solutus
Damna suis metuenda ferres.

Non tutiori carcere Virginem
Seruasse prudens Acrisius pater
Fertur, nec audacem catena
Pirithóum grauior repressit.

Sed qui supremo Numine temperat
Orbem, timores risit Ibericos:
Custode quum iussit remoto
Claustra patere tibi reclufa.

Sic liberatum nunc precibus piæ
Gentis Nouæum reddit amabilem:
Vxoris & charum redonat
Fletibus egregiæ maritum:

Qui magna ferret commoda patriæ,
Qui damna pulsis adderet hostibus
Dicenda, bellorum peritus
Milite seu duce vellet vti

page.notes: Marginal note at bottom right, set in italic: "Qu;" (partial, as printed). Faint show-through of text from the reverse page is visible in the margins and has been omitted. Two words in the first column of the Latin ("Pirithóum" in the fourth stanza) are a probable misprint for "Pirithoum"; kept as printed with a combining accent. Greek-style heavy ornaments are decorative only.
